name: Cafe Cozy Corner
description: Specialty coffee shop with house-roasted beans and cozy workspace seating.

customers.review: Excellent latte and very friendly baristas. Wi-Fi is also stable.
Great atmosphere and desserts, but parking is a bit limited.
The pour-over menu is impressive. Highly recommended for coffee lovers.

name: KFC Central Branch
description: Fast-food chicken restaurant with signature crispy menu and combo meals.

customers.review: Broth tastes deep and flavorful. Portion size is generous.
Good taste overall, but service was slow during peak hours.
Best spicy noodles in this area. I will definitely come back.

name: Pizza Town
description: Freshly baked pizza shop offering classic and fusion toppings.

customers.review: Fresh vegetables every time. Staff can explain product origins clearly.
Good quality fruits, slightly higher price but worth it.

name: Ramen Yoko
description: Japanese ramen restaurant known for rich broth and handmade noodles.

customers.review: Lovely curated titles and peaceful reading corner.
Helpful staff and good variety, but some imports are pricey.
Great place for weekend browsing. Their book club is excellent.

name: Shops Mart
description: Neighborhood convenience shop with daily essentials and snacks.

customers.review: Fresh seafood and nice ambience. Live music starts a bit late.
Perfect for dinner with friends. Grilled squid was amazing.
